description:
In Episode 238 we again team up with Heritage and Hope ministry to unravel the mystery behind the number 666 of Revelation 13, the number of the beast's name as well as the number of a man. We are admonished that there is wisdom in understanding this number. Join us as we unpack this most important subject.
